subject: Critical: FinChoice experiencing cascading resend loop causing elevated 5xx/429s
messages:
From: Samira Qureshi <samira@finchoice.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Spike in 5xx/429s — our traffic is looping

Hi Alex / Marissa,

We started seeing a big jump in 5xx and 429 responses around 07:45 ET and it coincides with a surge in retries from our side. We attached a short sample of the request stream and a screenshot of the dashboard (429s).

Symptoms: timeouts from your API, repeated identical requests from our proxy, and clients seeing degraded UX. We rolled back a small deploy but the retry rate stayed high. Can you confirm whether your endpoint saw a spike and whether any rate-limiting or throttling rule changed on your side?

We need an urgent sync — this is impacting a set of enterprise users.

Thanks,
Samira
Head of Platform Engineering
FinChoice

Attachments: api-logs-20261129.zip, screenshot-429s.png

From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@finchoice.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T08:28:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — our traffic is looping

Samira — thanks for the quick heads up and the artifacts. We can see a correlated spike in 5xx/429s from our edge near us-east-1 at the same timestamps. Attaching a short preliminary log extract, but we need to do a deeper investigation.

Immediate next steps:
- I'm looped in to run a request-tracing pass and surface whether the failures are originating from the runtime or upstream (model/pool saturation).
- Marissa will own customer updates and escalation.
- I'll pull in SRE (Vivek) and our Reliability lead (Grace) if we confirm retry amplification.

Can you confirm whether your client SDK has a custom backoff or if you're on our official SDK v1.8 default settings? Also, please confirm whether the proxy is re-sending idempotent requests or re-issuing on timeouts.

I'll update you in 30 mins with initial findings.

— Alex
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T08:42:00-05:00
Subject: Action: FinChoice elevated errors — possible client resend spiral (exec notice)

Vivek / Grace / Aditya — FinChoice is seeing a synchronized spike in 5xx/429s. External artifacts attached. Initial correlation shows:
- Bursts of identical request bodies from the customer's proxy within 1–2s windows.
- Backend edges return 429 then 5xx as capacity is strained, which appears to trigger more aggressive retransmits from the client side.

Hypothesis: incorrect backoff or aggressive retry defaults in their client/proxy causing cascading resends and capacity thrash.

Please prioritize:
1) Trace a sample request id (see attached finchoice-multiplex-request-sample.txt) end-to-end to determine whether failures are from our serving runtime or an upstream model pool manifesting as 5xx.
2) Short-term mitigation options: temporary conservative rate-limiter / per-account throttling or apply a token-bucket quota to smooth bursts.
3) Work with Marissa on an external customer note and Grace on an exec-level briefing.

If we confirm retry amplification, we should recommend immediate SDK config changes and publish a customer-facing advisory.

Thanks,
Alex

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T09:10:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Action: FinChoice elevated errors — possible client resend spiral (exec notice)

Quick notes from SRE triage:
- We replayed request ids from the zip — the runtime returned 429s when local queue depth exceeded the concurrency window, then 502s/503s as downstream model workers started shedding.
- Not seeing platform side config changes in the window — pointing at traffic pattern.

Short-term actions taken (applied at 09:05 ET):
- Applied a soft per-account token bucket for FinChoice with a 1.5x smoothing window to prevent immediate exhaust.
- Instrumented a tracing tag to mark client-retry vs first-attempt requests for metric separation.

Please coordinate the customer message; we need them to throttle client retries and change backoff. I'll keep the smoothing in place for 2 hours and observe.

— Vivek
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@finchoice.com>, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T09:25:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — our traffic is looping

Samira — thanks for your patience. Quick summary of what we found and recommendations:

Findings:
- We observed tight request bursts with identical payloads; many of the later attempts were tagged as retries by our new tracing header.
- Our runtime started returning 429s once request concurrency exceeded configured thresholds, and that led to model worker queueing and some 5xx error modes.

We recommend the following immediate customer actions:
- If you're on Redwood SDK v1.8, change exponential-backoff multiplier to 1.5 and add jitter (we can provide a one-line patch).
- Cap client-side retry attempts to max 3 for non-idempotent endpoints.
- If using a proxy, enable request deduplication for identical payloads within 2s windows.

We applied a temporary smoothing token-bucket on our side to keep the service online while you push a config change. Can you confirm the SDK/proxy change plan and ETA?

Thanks — I'll prepare a short exec note for any stakeholders.

— Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Qureshi <samira@finchoice.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: ops@finchoice.com, Naveen Rao <naveen@finchoice.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T16:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s — our traffic is looping

Marissa / Alex — we pushed the SDK change and proxy dedupe at 10:40 ET and the request churn dropped by ~85% within 15 minutes. The smoothing on your side prevented visible downtime while we rolled. We've attached a short follow-up log showing the drop.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will follow up with an SDK patch note and an advisory around default retry settings (we were on the default settings which amplified this)? Also, we'd like a short postmortem we can share with our ops leadership.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

— Samira
Head of Platform Engineering, FinChoice

Attachments: followup-log-after-smoothing.zip
